_note: Output of the real code on ILLUSTRATIVE fictional inputs.

input.text: Only 3 spots left! The #1 scheduling app - guaranteed results overnight.

findings.why_it_matters: Generic lines are interchangeable with competitors and give the buyer no reason to believe or act.
findings.fix: Replace with a concrete outcome, a specific customer, a number you can prove, or the customer's own words.

findings.why_it_matters: Unsubstantiated performance or superiority claims mislead buyers, break advertising law (e.g. FTC/ASA rules) and get ads rejected.
findings.fix: Add the evidence to context.substantiated_claims (and keep the source), soften to a verifiable statement, or remove.
evidence: The #1 scheduling app - guaranteed results overnight.

findings.message: Scarcity/urgency language without confirmed real constraint
findings.why_it_matters: Fake urgency erodes trust and can breach consumer-protection rules.
findings.fix: Only use a real deadline or capacity limit (set context.urgency_is_real=True once confirmed) or replace with a genuine reason to act now.

findings.why_it_matters: Absolute promises set expectations you cannot guarantee, cause refunds and trigger ad disapproval.
findings.fix: State the typical, evidenced outcome and conditions instead.

findings.why_it_matters: Without a specific next step, interested readers do nothing.
findings.fix: End with one action verb + what happens next (e.g. 'Book a 15-minute demo').

output.note: Internal quality gate. Passing it does not prove real-world performance or policy compliance.
